# mozilla — 2020 high-value CVEs (CVSS>=7, CISA KEV, Exploit-DB, or SSVC exploitation active/poc)

Full records for all 156 mozilla CVEs of 2020 are in `data/cve/vendors/mozilla/2020.jsonl`.

### CVE-2020-6804 — XSS in Mozilla WebThings Gateway
- Assigner: mozilla | Published: 2020-02-28 | Updated: 2024-08-04 | Max CVSS: 8.8
- CWE: CWE-79 CWE-79 Cross-site Scripting (XSS)
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 8.8 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`

A reflected XSS vulnerability exists within the gateway, allowing an attacker to craft a specialized URL which could steal the user's authentication token. When combined with CVE-2020-6803, an attacker could fully compromise the system.

**workarounds:** * Never share your gateway address publicly.
* Never click on links which take you to your gateway, especially to the login page.

**solutions:** https://github.com/mozilla-iot/gateway/pull/2446

Affected:
- Mozilla / WebThings Gateway: affected 0.3.0 <0.3.0* (custom); affected 0.12.0 <0.12.0 (custom)

Credits: Panagiotis

References:
- https://github.com/mozilla-iot/gateway/pull/2446 [x_refsource_MISC]

### CVE-2020-6817
- Assigner: mozilla | Published: 2023-02-16 | Updated: 2025-03-19 | Max CVSS: 7.5
- CWE: regular expression denial-of-service (ReDoS) in BleachSanitizerFilter.sanitize_css gauntlet regular expression; CWE-1333 CWE-1333 Inefficient Regular Expression Complexity
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 7.5 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=poc, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=partial

bleach.clean behavior parsing style attributes could result in a regular expression denial of service (ReDoS). Calls to bleach.clean with an allowed tag with an allowed style attribute are vulnerable to ReDoS. For example, bleach.clean(..., attributes={'a': ['style']}).

Affected:
- Mozilla / Mozilla Bleach: affected unspecified <3.1.4 (custom)

References:
- https://github.com/mozilla/bleach/security/advisories/GHSA-vqhp-cxgc-6wmm
- https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1623633

### CVE-2020-6819
- Assigner: mozilla | Published: 2020-04-24 | Updated: 2025-10-21 | Max CVSS: 8.1
- CWE: Use-after-free while running the nsDocShell destructor; CWE-416 CWE-416 Use After Free
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 8.1 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=active, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total
- **CISA KEV**: added 2021-11-03, ransomware=Unknown — Mozilla Firefox And Thunderbird Use-After-Free Vulnerability

Under certain conditions, when running the nsDocShell destructor, a race condition can cause a use-after-free. We are aware of targeted attacks in the wild abusing this flaw. This vulnerability affects Thunderbird < 68.7.0, Firefox < 74.0.1, and Firefox ESR < 68.6.1.

Affected:
- Mozilla / Thunderbird: affected unspecified <68.7.0 (custom)
- Mozilla / Firefox: affected unspecified <74.0.1 (custom)
- Mozilla / Firefox ESR: affected unspecified <68.6.1 (custom)

References:
- https://www.mozilla.org/security/advisories/mfsa2020-14/ [x_refsource_MISC]
- https://www.mozilla.org/security/advisories/mfsa2020-11/ [x_refsource_MISC]
- https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1620818 [x_refsource_MISC]

### CVE-2020-15679
- Assigner: mozilla | Published: 2022-12-22 | Updated: 2025-04-16 | Max CVSS: 7.6
- CWE: OAuth Session Fixation on VPN login; CWE-384 CWE-384 Session Fixation
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 7.6 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=partial

An OAuth session fixation vulnerability existed in the VPN login flow, where an attacker could craft a custom login URL, convince a VPN user to login via that URL, and obtain authenticated access as that user. This issue is limited to cases where attacker and victim are sharing the same source IP and could allow the ability to view session states and disconnect VPN sessions. This vulnerability affects Mozilla VPN iOS 1.0.7 < (929), Mozilla VPN Windows < 1.2.2, and Mozilla VPN Android 1.1.0 < (1360).

Affected:
- Mozilla / Mozilla VPN iOS 1.0.7: affected unspecified <(929) (custom)
- Mozilla / Mozilla VPN Windows: affected unspecified <1.2.2 (custom)
- Mozilla / Mozilla VPN Android 1.1.0: affected unspecified <(1360) (custom)

References:
- https://www.mozilla.org/security/advisories/mfsa2020-48/
- https://github.com/mozilla-services/guardian-vpn-windows/commit/ac6f562973a83f6758cd7ab7aa313e863047d41b
- https://github.com/mozilla-mobile/guardian-vpn-android/commit/981c840276ef3aee98cf5d42993d484ee99b28d9
- https://github.com/mozilla-mobile/guardian-vpn-ios/commit/4309f5c9bd2c15cdfd39ac173665fad3f2598b54

### CVE-2020-37190 — Top Password Firefox Password Recovery 2.8 - Denial of Service
- Assigner: VulnCheck | Published: 2026-02-11 | Updated: 2026-02-12 | Max CVSS: 7.5
- CWE: CWE-120 Buffer Copy without Checking Size of Input ('Classic Buffer Overflow')
- CVSS 4.0 (cna): 4.6 MEDIUM `CVSS:4.0/AV:L/AC:L/AT:N/PR:N/UI:A/VC:N/VI:N/VA:L/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N`
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 7.5 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=poc, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=partial

Top Password Firefox Password Recovery 2.8 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows attackers to crash the application by overflowing input fields. Attackers can trigger the vulnerability by inserting 5000 characters into the User Name or Registration Code input fields.

Affected:
- Top Password Software / Top Password Firefox Password Recovery: affected 2.8

Credits: Antonio de la Piedra

References:
